report.title: Bill Pay refuses mismatched account numbers
report.summary: The Bill Pay page should refuse payment requests with mismatched account numbers. However, it sent a payment request with mismatched account numbers.
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Log in to the ParaBank website.
2. Go to the Bill Pay page.
3. Enter a payment request with mismatched account numbers.
report.expected: The Bill Pay page should refuse the payment request and display an error message.
report.actual: The Bill Pay page sent a payment request with mismatched account numbers.
evidence: The account numbers do not match.
a rejected form sent a payment request: ['http://localhost:8080/parabank/services_proxy/bank/billpay?accountId=0&amount=1']
report.suspected_cause: The Bill Pay page's validation logic may be faulty.
report.next_action: The development team should investigate and fix the Bill Pay page's validation logic to prevent sending payment requests with mismatched account numbers.
